words.prose: {{ar:نَحْنُ}} ({{tr:naḥnu}}) makes the speakers step forward as an explicit collective subject. Its passive participial form presents them as affected recipients: deprivation has been imposed, but the depriving agent is left unnamed. The missing complement also matters; the crop scene supplies the occasion, yet the word does not specify only one lost object, so the verdict expands toward being cut off from provision or good. The wider {{ar:ح ر م}} ({{tr:ḥ-r-m}}) field gives this deprivation a boundary image: the local sense is not ritual consecration or a declaration of sacred law, but the speakers feel barred from access, as though provision stands behind a boundary they cannot cross. The word also answers {{ar:لَمُغْرَمُونَ}} ({{tr:lamughramūna}}) in 56:66 with a near sound frame and a harsher sense, shifting from measurable burden to categorical exclusion. Because the same deprived category appears beside the asker in 51:19 and 70:25, the word can sound larger than a one-time harvest failure while still remaining the quoted speakers' hyperbolic self-diagnosis here.

context_deltas.mechanism: The following water and fire episodes generalize the crop failure into a chain of supplied conversions: a resource must arrive, become accessible, be released from a carrier, and become useful. Deprivation can occur at any gate even when human use is visible at the end.

activation_trace.role: The desired provision that fails to reach a claimant supplies the recurring endpoint.
Water conveyed for use supplies a prerequisite that must reach the user before benefit is possible.
Delivery from above supplies the transfer gate by which an available resource becomes locally accessible.
Latent fire released from its carrier supplies a second transformation from hidden capacity to usable energy.
A means useful for need and subsistence supplies the practical endpoint shared by crop, water, and fire.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies delivery, release, and utility in parallel resource episodes; I infer homologous conversion gates and read the focus as one instance of dependency across the chain. The alternative is that the later episodes repeat the argument without enlarging the focus term.

changed_reading.before: One harvest has been denied to us.
changed_reading.after: Our deprivation exposes dependence on every transfer that makes a resource present, usable, and sustaining.

changed_reading.after: The product may be materially present yet locked into a brittle or unusable condition, making presence itself a form of deprivation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads the lament as a claim about a breached relation rather than a report of inventory. surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus root permits deprivation to resonate with a protected claim, obligation, or relation.

activation_trace.role: A protected right or binding relation supplies the juridical coloring of the speakers' complaint.
A material due or right supplies an accounting frame that can test the complaint's asserted claim.

changed_reading.after: Our cry of deprivation stakes a claim about a breached due relation while the surrounding discourse audits the legitimacy of that claim.

strongest_changes: The crop sequence shifts generic lack into a blocked conversion from labor and seed to living, usable yield.
The adjacent financial-burden clause makes deprivation cost without return rather than empty-handedness alone.
Repeated agent contrasts expand denied possession into possible exclusion from decisive productive control.
summary.what_was_special: The bare focus clause acts as a hinge: its objectless deprivation can absorb the local crop mechanism and then echo across water and fire without collapsing those episodes into one object.
remaining_uncertainties: The focus may still name only final material shortfall rather than the blocked process or excluded agency inferred from the sequence.
The protected-claim and material-hardening readings are branch-grounded but remain analogical and should not displace the strong deprivation sense.

occurrence_evidence_trim.note: TRIMMED, NOT ABSENT. dictionary_entry.occurrence_evidence.occurrences and .ayahs are removed from every root by design: they are a per-occurrence QAC concordance and character-span alignment table carrying zero readings, branches or senses, and they dominated bundle size (~1.5 MB for a single common root). occurrence_evidence.summary (corpus frequency) and .forms (inflectional inventory) are retained. Dictionary/gloss branches are kept in full for every included Furuq root target.

branch_policy.note: No branch filtering is applied. Every branch present in each included dictionary/gloss root entry is kept.

root_mapping.policy: Use the dominant Furuq root for every QAC root, and include non-dominant Furuq targets as additional root_lexicon entries when qac-furuq-v4-root-map marks the QAC root as split.
